why: The answer depends on organic sewage raising biochemical oxygen demand so that microbial decomposition depletes dissolved oxygen and fish die - the water-pollution material of the Environmental Issues chapter, which the list does not contain.
note: TAXONOMY GAP: expected an 'Environmental Issues' chapter (water pollution, BOD, eutrophication, air pollution). Microbes in Human Welfare touches BOD only in the context of sewage-treatment plants, and Ecosystem does not teach pollution, so no listed chapter actually teaches this fact.
